CME Crypto Derivatives Trading Volume Reaches $469.5B in Q3

CME Group reported record third-quarter revenue of $1.74 billion, up about 13% year over year, with net income of roughly $1 billion. Crypto derivatives averaged about 196,000 contracts per day during the quarter, representing approximately $469.5 billion in notional trading volume, including $326.7 billion in Bitcoin derivatives and $118.8 billion in Ether derivatives. — link

Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand Central Banks Push Cross-Border Stablecoin and Tokenized Deposit Settlement

According to MAS, the central banks of Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand will work with industry participants on cross-border settlement using regulated stablecoins, tokenized deposits and other forms of digital money. Ripple, Visa, Mastercard, Airwallex and the World Bank Group are among the new participants, with work focused on interoperability between payment networks and programmable compliance controls. — link

On October 22 (ET), spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded total net outflows of $635M, led by BlackRock’s IBIT with $254M. Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded total net outflows of $111M, led by BlackRock’s ETHA with $75.45M. — link

Ethereum Postpones Glamsterdam Upgrade on Hoodi Testnet Over EIP-8037 Compatibility Concerns

According to the Ethereum Foundation, Ethereum core developers have postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet, originally scheduled for October 26, to further investigate compatibility concerns between EIP-8037's gas accounting changes and existing mainnet smart contracts. The planned increase of Hoodi's gas limit to 200 million has also been canceled. Node operators must update their clients to prevent activation of the fork as originally scheduled.
